allowed_dispositions_considered.rejected_because: It asserts technical values were frozen and await only sign-off. Nothing was frozen. This lane bound zero new numeric pre-launch budgets.

This implies some values were frozen and only the remainder are outstanding. The split is actually 40 already bound by frozen authority - unchanged from HQ196 - against 38 still pending. No value moved from pending to bound in this lane, so PARTIAL would misdescribe the delta. NO_NEW_VALUES_LAWFULLY_BINDABLE is the accurate description.

allowed_dispositions_considered.why: Binding law gate 2 requires the candidate's control flow to make a value exact and source-independent AT THE GOVERNED SCOPE. Every pending count lives in a SourceAccessBroker whose scope is one _decode() invocation, and no per-source session owner binds a warrant source entry to exactly one governed decode. Gate 2 therefore fails uniformly, and no value can lawfully move.

allowed_dispositions_considered.rejected_because: No contradiction exists between governing contracts. Three candidate-versus-authority discrepancies were found and are recorded as open findings, not as contract contradictions: the missing decoder-invocation counter, the unconditional header-prefix read, and the unproven governed scope. Each is a gap to close, not two contracts that cannot both hold.

headline: The repaired broker is a large advance on ENFORCEABILITY and no advance at all on AUTHORITY. 64 of 78 accounts are now measurable and cap-able before the operation; 31 of those still have no numeric pre-launch budget; 7 have no counter at all. Zero numeric budgets were bound.

what_the_candidate_audit_proved_and_did_.proved: A positive-controlled static AST audit of the accepted C4 closure (21 accepted modules plus the broker = 22) finds exactly ONE source-path open SITE, at broker:326 open(self.path), and ZERO raw path strings reaching pyreadstat. The auditor reports 2 raw-path reader calls on the out-of-closure WVS7 materializer, so the zero is a real negative. Three of the auditor's own false-zero defects were found and fixed.
what_the_candidate_audit_proved_and_did_.did_not_prove: A count of open SITES is not a count of opens PER SOURCE at the governed warrant scope. SourceAccessBudget.path_opens defaults to 1, but its own docstring calls the caps policy ceilings that are not claims about expected behaviour.

open_findings.statement: No per-source session owner exists, so no count account is exact at the governed scope.
open_findings.missing_owner: A warrant/execution-surface-level per-source session owner constructed once per bound source entry, shared by every admitted operation for that source, closed deterministically rather than by caller discipline, and making aggregate per-source counts enforceable at that scope.

open_findings.statement: The O1-C07 mandatory account decoder_invocations has zero occurrences in the repaired broker. SourceAccessAccount counts reader_invocations but has no decoder-entry counter, and the receipt's measurement_basis lists none.
open_findings.missing_owner: A decoder-entry counter at the _decode boundary, distinct from reader_invocations, with its own pre-operation cap.
open_findings.note: reader_invocations is not a substitute. Under the settled non-substitutability law a reader invocation may not be renamed a decoder call.

open_findings.statement: decoder:639 calls broker.header_prefix(176 if SAV else 512) unconditionally for every source, but frozen authority admits a header-prefix read only for SRC26. On the SRC02/SRC06/SRC14 selected route and on SRC08/SRC12/SRC27 this is a scope excess relative to the admitted operation class.
open_findings.why_not_bound_either_way: Binding 1 would authorise an unadmitted operation; binding 0 would contradict the candidate's control flow.

open_findings.statement: reader_bytes is now enforceable via a bridge-safe limiter that never raises inside the read callback and raises a typed READER_BYTES_LIMIT_EXCEEDED at the outer decode boundary, with exact accounting at refusal. That supplies no numeric real-source ceiling, and none may be derived from synthetic carrier totals or source size.

The physical-selected interpretation (HQ197 determination A) has not received independent HQ198 acceptance. Frozen selected_reads=1 / full_reads=0 for SRC02/SRC06/SRC14 remain bound at EXACT and were NOT loosened; only the newly dependent interpretation field is conditional.
